parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, facility ban, border/document friction, or police targeting is documented; same-sex conduct is lawful and anti-discrimination law expressly covers gender identity, though described as vague and rarely enforced. Resident LGR/marriage material is only a climate signal, not a visitor protection. The main exposure is societal hostility concentrated around the 2023 capital Pride—threats, flag-burning, eggs and a minor-injury assault investigated by police—plus institutional shortcomings and weak hate-crime tracking. The 17/25 bias counts are raw, denominator-free and cannot establish per-capita prevalence, and NGO 'prevalent' claims are under-reported. Head-of-state participation and official condemnations provide some protection, but uneven ministerial response and thin recourse keep it below reduced-risk tiers with demonstrated enforcement.
